items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm telling you. I talked to Freddie Landry for a month there about that band. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, I wonder if it did. I wonder if Mr. James would know. James Landry in the next block.

ctx.x: It was. My father belonged to that band.
I'm telling you. I talked to Freddie Landry for a month there about that band.

Oh, I wonder if it did. I wonder if Mr. James would know. James Landry in the next block. I wonder if he would know. You know, he'd get some doubts, you know. I'm going to ask him and find out, you know. But my father belonged to that band because they played at his funeral. And I was 14 years old when he died. I remember that. Oh, that goes through you. Those bands playing at funerals, you know. That's right. It's so sad. Oh, I wonder why they would do that. And when they hit that drum, oh, it just goes through…
